name: likes_vs_reads
title: Add a like vs read a person's posts (the ratio sweep's base workload)
expect: the winner switches from Condensed/Chunked adjacency to Split adjacency as likes grow
why: reading a person's posts wants Message properties Chunked ({ch_posts} ops against {cc_posts} Condensed) or Split (fewest bytes); writing a like wants the likes lists Split ({sp_like} against {cc_like}, which a Condensed list also reads first). A mixed layout gives each part its own layout; see the sweep for where the uniform winner flips.
